blocks.title: TMUnlimiter
blocks.tagline: Lifts block and map limits in TrackMania Forever; version 2.0 adds AngelScript map scripts.

items.title: No limits
items.text: Removes the block and map limits of TrackMania Forever.

items.title: Documentation
items.text: A documentation site and a wiki with the AngelScript reference.

blocks.title: Install and notes
blocks.markdown:
TMUnlimiter is installed through the TrackMania ModLoader. The TMInterface guide has a chapter on playing with TMUnlimiter.

Documentation lives on unlimiter.net and in the wiki of the repository; the author plans to move the documentation into the repository.
